_note: ADD132's draft of 2026-10-05, the one §17.1376 let through: gates ACCEPTED it with `suggested: run` and zero refusals. Two defects it still carries -- (1) the Radarr heredoc uses `os.environ[...]` with only `import json`, so NameError under `set -euo pipefail`; (2) the body files are written on the HOST and read with `-d @path` INSIDE guests 103/104, which cannot see them. Defect 2 is what FILE_RULES' own §17.1375 example taught. Secrets by NAME only.

files.content:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------- 1. Hash the password ON THE HOST ----------
HASH=$(python3 - <<'EOF'
import base64, hashlib, os
salt = os.urandom(16)
key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha512', os.environ['MASS_PASSWORD'].encode(), salt, 100000, 64)
print('@ByteArray(' + base64.b64encode(salt).decode() + ':' + base64.b64encode(key).decode() + ')')
EOF
)

# ---------- 2. Stop qBittorrent, set username + hash, start it ----------
pct exec 105 -- systemctl stop qbittorrent-nox.service
pct exec 105 -- sed -i '/^\[Preferences\]/a WebUI\\Username=admin\nWebUI\\Password_PBKDF2='"$HASH" /var/lib/qbittorrent-nox/.config/qBittorrent/qBittorrent.conf
pct exec 105 -- systemctl start qbittorrent-nox.service
sleep 3

# ---------- 3. PROVE the login from the host ----------
LOGIN_RESULT=$(curl -s -d "username=admin&password=$MASS_PASSWORD" http://192.168.1.24:8080/api/v2/auth/login)
if [ "$LOGIN_RESULT" != "Ok." ]; then
    echo "qBittorrent login failed. Got: $LOGIN_RESULT"
    exit 1
fi
echo "qBittorrent login: Ok."

# ---------- 4. Update Radarr download client ----------
RADARR_KEY=$(pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'cat /var/lib/radarr/config.xml | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\(.*\)</ApiKey>.*:\1:p" | head -n 1' | tr -d '\r\n')

# Fetch existing download client, fix priority, add credentials
pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'curl -s -H "X-Api-Key: '"$RADARR_KEY"'" http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient' > /tmp/radarr_dc.json

python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
with open('/tmp/radarr_dc.json') as f:
    clients = json.load(f)
if not clients:
    print("No download client found in Radarr")
    exit(1)
client = clients[0]
client['enable'] = True
client['priority'] = 1
client['fields'] = [
    {"name": "host", "value": "192.168.1.24"},
    {"name": "port", "value": 8080},
    {"name": "username", "value": "admin"},
    {"name": "password", "value": os.environ['MASS_PASSWORD']},
    {"name": "movieCategory", "value": "radarr"}
]
with open('/tmp/radarr_dc_update.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(client, f)
EOF

pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT -H "X-Api-Key: '"$RADARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @/tmp/radarr_dc_update.json http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/'"$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("/tmp/radarr_dc.json"))[0]["id"])')"

# ---------- 5. Update Sonarr download client ----------
SONARR_KEY=$(pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'cat /var/lib/sonarr/config.xml | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\(.*\)</ApiKey>.*:\1:p" | head -n 1' | tr -d '\r\n')

pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'curl -s -H "X-Api-Key: '"$SONARR_KEY"'" http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient' > /tmp/sonarr_dc.json

python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os
with open('/tmp/sonarr_dc.json') as f:
    clients = json.load(f)
if not clients:
    print("No download client found in Sonarr")
    exit(1)
client = clients[0]
client['enable'] = True
client['priority'] = 1
client['fields'] = [
    {"name": "host", "value": "192.168.1.24"},
    {"name": "port", "value": 8080},
    {"name": "username", "value": "admin"},
    {"name": "password", "value": os.environ['MASS_PASSWORD']},
    {"name": "tvCategory", "value": "tv-sonarr"}
]
with open('/tmp/sonarr_dc_update.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(client, f)
EOF

pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT -H "X-Api-Key: '"$SONARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @/tmp/sonarr_dc_update.json http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/'"$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("/tmp/sonarr_dc.json"))[0]["id"])')"

# ---------- 6. Test both connections ----------
echo "--- Radarr test ---"
pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: '"$RADARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @/tmp/radarr_dc_update.json http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/test'

echo ""
echo "--- Sonarr test ---"
pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: '"$SONARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @/tmp/sonarr_dc_update.json http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/test'
